adjudication.common_core_histories: Use the largest set of histories qualified for every adjacent ladder pair; report pair-specific exclusions. Never score an outside-domain history as zero error.
adjudication.RESOLUTION_CONVERGENCE_CLEAR: On each adjacent common cohort, higher resolution is non-inferior within 1e-12 cm floating equality for both max common-band storage error and max cumulative bottom-exchange error, with no increase in sign/reversal mismatch counts; at least one primary metric improves strictly across each adjacent pair.
adjudication.RESOLUTION_EFFECT_MIXED: At least one adjacent higher-resolution member materially worsens a primary storage/exchange/sign/reversal component.
adjudication.ASYMPTOTIC_BOUNDARY_MISMATCH: R16 retains non-negligible exchange error while common-band storage is near fine-grid identity; report as boundary/time-discretization residual rather than spatial-reduction error.
